title: 第9章 发小要报仇第10章 嫂子的异样
slug: 觉醒阴阳神功分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
“他不是一天就赢了100多万吗？”苏冰打断她的话，眼神里带着几分笃定，“能在赌石场上有这么好的运气，他不会那么容易死的。”
说完，苏冰径直走向电梯口，杨婷和两名保镖连忙跟上。
走出医院，一辆黑色的豪车早已等候在门口。
苏冰拉开车门坐了进去，杨婷和保镖也迅速上车，车子缓缓发动，朝着远处驶去。
病房里，陈阳坐了一会儿，只觉得肚子饿得咕咕叫，浑身无力。
他转头看向床头柜，发现自己的手机正放在上面，屏幕漆黑，显然是没电了。
他连忙按下电源键，确认手机没电后，挣扎着坐起身，朝着门口喊了一声护士。
护士很快走了进来，陈阳语气客气说：“护士，麻烦给我拿一个充电器，我的手机没电了。”
护士点了点头，转身去拿了充电器，递给了他。
陈阳将手机插上电，耐心等待着。
几分钟后，手机终于开机，屏幕亮起的瞬间，就弹出了两条未接来电提醒，都是宋萌萌打来的。
他点开微信，里面还有宋萌萌发来的好几条消息，语气亲昵，还附带了几个俏皮的表情包，看得出来，她很是关心自己。
陈阳看着屏幕，心里五味杂陈。
经历了昨天被赵凯和唐欣悦背叛的事情后，他一下觉得自己不能再和宋萌萌走得太近了。
她是发小李恒的新婚妻子，若是被李恒知道两人走得太近，难免会心生误会，影响两人多年的兄弟情。
他轻轻叹了口气，退出微信，点开美团，正准备点些外卖填肚子，病房门突然被轻轻推开，一男一女走了进来。
陈阳抬眸一看，瞬间愣住了。
来人正是李恒和宋萌萌。
李恒穿着一身休闲装，头发有些凌乱，脸上带着几分急切，眼神里满是担忧。
宋萌萌则穿着一条浅色连衣裙，妆容精致，依旧是那张娇俏的娃娃脸，肌肤白皙，身姿窈窕。

只是她此刻脸上满是焦急，眼底还带着几分后怕，一看就是匆匆赶过来的。
陈阳连忙坐起身，语气里满是意外：“恒哥、嫂子，你们怎么来了？”
李恒和宋萌萌看到陈阳头上厚厚的纱布，脸色瞬间变得紧张起来，快步冲到病床边。
宋萌萌率先开口，语气急切又担忧：“我们打你电话打不通，去你出租屋找你，也没找到人。
后来我们给唐欣悦打电话，她才说你在医院，我们一路打听，问了医生，才找到你这间病房。”
李恒一把抓住陈阳的手，语气激动，眼神里满是怒火和心疼：“阳子，这究竟是怎么回事？
谁把你打成这样的？
还有，我给唐欣悦打电话，她怎么一直不接？
你们俩到底怎么了？”
陈阳看着李恒急切的眼神，心里一暖，语气低沉说：“恒哥，你别再给她打电话了，我跟她已经分手了。”
“什么？分了？”李恒彻底傻眼了，脸上写满了不解，“你们俩不是好好的吗？
前段时间你还跟我说，要攒钱给她买戒指、办婚宴，怎么突然就分了？”
一旁的宋萌萌也满脸意外，眉头微微皱起，疑惑地看着陈阳：“是啊，陈阳，你和欣悦不是一直很恩爱吗？
怎么会突然分手？”
content_en:
"Didn't he win more than 1 million in one day?" Su Bing interrupted her, with a certain certainty in her eyes, "With such good luck in the stone betting field, he will not die so easily."
After saying that, Su Bing walked straight to the elevator, and Yang Ting and two bodyguards quickly followed.
Walking out of the hospital, a black luxury car was already waiting at the door.
Su Bing opened the car door and got in. Yang Ting and her bodyguard quickly got into the car. The car started slowly and drove towards the distance.
In the ward, Chen Yang sat for a while, feeling his stomach growling with hunger and feeling weak all over.
He turned to look at the bedside table and found that his mobile phone was placed on it. The screen was black, and it was obviously out of battery.
He quickly pressed the power button and after confirming that the phone was out of battery, he struggled to sit up and called the nurse towards the door.
The nurse came in quickly, and Chen Yang said in a polite tone: "Nurse, please get me a charger, my phone is out of battery."
The nurse nodded, turned around to get the charger, and handed it to him.
Chen Yang plugged in his phone and waited patiently.
A few minutes later, the phone finally turned on. The moment the screen turned on, two missed call reminders popped up, both from Song Mengmeng.
He clicked on WeChat, and there were several messages from Song Mengmeng, with a friendly tone and a few playful emoticons. It was obvious that she cared about him very much.
Chen Yang looked at the screen with mixed feelings in his heart.
After experiencing yesterday's betrayal by Zhao Kai and Tang Xinyue, he suddenly felt that he could no longer get too close to Song Mengmeng.
She is the newlywed wife of Fa Xiao Li Heng. If Li Heng knew that the two were too close, there would inevitably be misunderstandings, which would affect the brotherhood between the two for many years.
He sighed softly, logged out of WeChat, clicked on Meituan, and was about to order some takeout to fill his stomach. Suddenly, the ward door was gently pushed open, and a man and a woman walked in.
Chen Yang raised his eyes and was stunned for a moment.
The visitors were none other than Li Heng and Song Mengmeng.
Li Heng was wearing casual clothes, his hair was a little messy, his face was a little anxious, and his eyes were full of worry.
Song Mengmeng was wearing a light-colored dress with exquisite makeup. She still had the same cute baby face, fair skin and slim figure.
It's just that her face is full of anxiety at the moment, and there is a bit of fear in her eyes. It seems that she has rushed here in a hurry.
Chen Yang sat up quickly, his tone full of surprise: "Brother Heng, sister-in-law, why are you here?"
When Li Heng and Song Mengmeng saw the thick gauze on Chen Yang's head, their faces instantly became nervous and they rushed to the bedside.
Song Mengmeng was the first to speak, with an urgent and worried tone: "We couldn't get through when we called you, and we went to your rental house to look for you, but we couldn't find anyone.
Later we called Tang Xinyue and she said you were in the hospital. We asked all the way and asked the doctor before we found your ward. "
Li Heng grabbed Chen Yang's hand and spoke in an excited tone, his eyes full of anger and distress: "Yangzi, what on earth is going on?
Who beat you like this?
Also, when I called Tang Xinyue, why didn’t she answer the phone?
What's wrong with you two? "
Chen Yang looked at Li Heng's eager eyes and felt warm in his heart. He said in a low tone: "Brother Heng, please stop calling her. She and I have broken up."
"What? Broken up?" Li Heng was completely dumbfounded, with confusion written on his face, "Aren't you two in good company?
Some time ago, you told me that you were going to save money to buy her a ring and host a wedding banquet. Why did we suddenly break up? "
Song Mengmeng on the side also had a surprised look on her face, her brows furrowed slightly, and she looked at Chen Yang doubtfully: "Yes, Chen Yang, haven't you and Xinyue always been very affectionate?
Why did they break up suddenly? "
